validate_narrative_quality: validate a narrative text for minimum dialogue exchanges, word count, and required player presence
get_narrative_retry_feedback: get specific retry feedback with improvement suggestions when a narrative fails quality validation
get_narrative_quality_report: get a quality report with metrics like dialogue count, word count, and scene count
add_narrative_to_history: add a narrative to the history manager, automatically chunking it by scene headings
summarize_narrative_for_gm_memory: summarize key events and outcomes from a narrative for game master memory storage
